<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 10"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Jaathoom's Scarf](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2582)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Air" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=5" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 75

**Price** 900 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn belt

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This scarf is made of fine silk that's the same shade of blue as a clear, cloudless sky. The short ends are edged with a fine gold fringe that seems to sway even in still weather as though touched by invisible winds. The long edges have exquisite embroidery in threads that vary from a blue identical to the silk to the deep gray of storm clouds during winter. Wearing this scarf grants a +2 item bonus to [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) checks to dance and to [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) checks to [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=79).

**Activate—Vanish
** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The scarf casts 4th-rank [_invisibility_](/Spells.aspx?ID=164) on you.

**Activate—Jaathoom's Rebuke
** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** You let the winds around you catch the edges of the _jaathoom's scarf_, and a jaathoom shuyookh appears with a sudden updraft. The winds force your enemies back, granting you some breathing room in battle. Each enemy in a 10-foot emanation must succeed at a DC 27 Fortitude save or be [pushed](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) 10 feet. A creature that critically fails is also knocked [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=31) after being moved. Creatures with the [air](/Traits.aspx?ID=5) trait are immune to all these effects.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
